overall_goal: Add water, lemon juice, and basmati rice to the pressure cooker and mix well.

goals.description: Prepare the measuring jug and tumbler
goals.rationale: The person removes a plastic jug from the glass measuring jug, puts it away, and empties rice grains from a tumbler to prepare these utensils for measuring water.

goals.description: Fill the measuring jug with water
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly fills the tumbler from the water cooler and pours it into the measuring jug until the desired amount of water is reached.

goals.description: Add water to the pressure cooker
goals.rationale: The person pours the measured water from the jug into the pressure cooker and stirs the contents.

goals.description: Extract and add lemon juice to the pressure cooker
goals.rationale: The person removes seeds from a lemon slice, squeezes the juice into a spoon, and adds it to the pressure cooker.

goals.description: Stir the contents and adjust the heat
goals.rationale: The person stirs the mixture in the pressure cooker and adjusts the temperature on the electric hob.

goals.description: Add basmati rice to the pressure cooker
goals.rationale: The person stirs the contents one more time before pouring the bowl of basmati rice into the pressure cooker.

goals.description: Mix the rice with the masala
goals.rationale: The person stirs the newly added rice into the masala mixture, adjusts the heat, and scrapes the spatula clean.
